changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cde_schedule ( id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY, arrival_id UUID NOT NULL, sequence INT NOT NULL, process_date DATE NOT NULL, version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), UNIQUE (arrival_id, sequence) );
